mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (primary_key, enterprise_code, status, un_passed_deal, un_passed_remark, remark, dispatcher_remark, finish_date, inspect_user, passed_num, un_passed_num, inspect_type, inspect_ratio, should_inspect_num, inspect_num, check_items, finish_main_id, files, approved_flag, batch_no) VALUES (#{data.primaryKeyValue}, #{data.enterpriseCode}, #{data.status}, #{data.unPassedDeal}, #{data.unPassedRemark}, #{data.remark}, #{data.dispatcherRemark}, #{data.finishDate}, #{data.inspectUser}, #{data.passedNum}, #{data.unPassedNum}, #{data.inspectType}, #{data.inspectRatio}, #{data.shouldInspectNum}, #{data.inspectNum}, #{data.checkItems}, #{data.finishMainId}, #{data.fileList}, #{data.approvedFlag}, #{data.batchNo})
mapper.select: with t as (select a.finish_main_id, a.batch_no, sum(a.inspect_num) as inspect_num from ${reportTable} a where a.finish_main_id = #{finishMainId} and a.batch_no = #{batchNo} and a.inspect_user = #{inspectUserCode} GROUP BY a.finish_main_id, a.batch_no) select a.procedure_name, a.model, a.pcs_name, a.product_or_part, a.product_or_part_name, a.batch_num, a.check_items, b.inspect_type, b.inspect_ratio, b.allocation_num as should_inspect_num, b.finish_date, b.finish_main_id, b.batch_no, t.inspect_num, a.check_items from ${finishTable} a LEFT JOIN ${dispatcherTable} b on a.primary_key = b.finish_main_id LEFT JOIN t on t.finish_main_id = b.finish_main_id and t.batch_no = b.batch_no where b.finish_main_id = #{finishMainId} and b.batch_no = #{batchNo} and b.inspect_user_code = #{inspectUserCode} and a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.delete_flag = false
